title: Listening Drill — Optics class demonstration — Trial review
description: Conversation about a trial. One synthetic recording, six questions. Recommended time: 7 minutes.

sections.title: Optics class demonstration — Trial review
sections.transcript:
HOST: You ran two introductory sessions on optics class demonstration last week. What happened in the first one?

GUEST: On the first run, several people reported a problem with blurred image. At first we wondered whether it was a problem with the instructions. A closer inspection revealed the fault: cracked holder.

HOST: What changed when you ran the session again?

GUEST: On each trial, we now keep a record of lens distance so changes can be compared. For the second trial we let everyone borrow paper screen instead of bringing their own. That helped us keep the equipment as consistent as possible.

HOST: What should people who attended do now?

GUEST: Send any suggestions directly to the lab instructor before the next group arrives. The next group comes on Friday, so we have time to compare notes beforehand.
